parsed.attack: The invitation goes to the other parent in the same house at four in the morning, which is the highest-converting install in this whole set and also is not distribution: recruiting the person asleep next to you is a second seat on one account, so the coefficient is exactly 1.0 and then terminates - no household ever invites another household. Household-to-household growth requires a friend to have a baby, a cycle measured in years, and by the idea's own kill criterion your users are gone by week 12, which is before they would ever refer anyone. Meanwhile store search sends 'baby tracker' to Huckleberry and Baby Tracker with six-figure ratings counts and the strong day-7 retention both stores now weight above download volume.
parsed.strongest_defence: Antenatal cohorts are the channel: an NCT or hospital birth class is eight to ten couples due the same month who are in a WhatsApp group together through exactly the twelve weeks this product owns, so one adopting couple seeds a whole cohort inside a month for nothing.
parsed.verdict_reason: The invite is an activation mechanic that saturates at two people in one household; the household-to-household cycle is measured in years and the user churns before it turns.
